articles.title: One Is the Pope, the Other an Atheist. They Both Oppose Trump.
articles.summary: Pope Leo XIV and Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez of Spain, who met on Monday, have recently clashed with President Trump. Their motivations, however, may be different.
articles.title_zh: 一个是教皇，另一个是无神论者。他们都反对特朗普。

articles.title: Pentagon expands list of China military-linked firms to include Alibaba, Baidu in fresh blow to diplomatic thaw
articles.summary: The Pentagon briefly posted a similar expanded list in February, then withdrew it without explanation before Trump's China trip.
articles.title_zh: 五角大楼扩大了与中国军方有关的公司名单，将阿里巴巴、百度包括在内，对外交解冻造成新的打击

articles.title: China stresses Taiwan at 'core of core interests' after Xi-Trump call; Room for 'relying on US for independence' illusion will only shrink further: expert
articles.title_zh: 在习近平通话后，中国强调台湾是“核心利益的核心” ； “依靠美国独立”的幻想空间只会进一步缩小：专家

articles.title: Trump claims India will buy Venezuelan oil, welcomes China's investment; Chinese expert notices remarks 'unilateral,' no confirmation from Indian side

articles.title: Beijing Signals Readiness to Talk to Trump's Team, Even Old Foes
articles.summary: The Chinese foreign minister spoke by phone with Marco Rubio, the new secretary of state who has been a critic of Beijing.
articles.title_zh: 北京表示愿意与特朗普的团队对话，即使是老对手

articles.title: Canada Is Becoming a Fentanyl Exporter, and a Target for Trump
articles.summary: The drug is increasingly manufactured in and trafficked from the U.S.’s northern neighbor, though the numbers remain small compared with Mexico.
articles.title_zh: 加拿大正在成为芬太尼出口国，也是特朗普的目标
